{{Description|Angels' ability with magic is unparalleled as they have the innate power to infuse mana into everything they touch. Affiliating yourself with the Angels faction will grant you nearly unlimited spell power and the ability to take advantage of it directly.}}

== The Angel Faction ==
[[File:Angelchampion.png|left|Angel Champion Trophy]]
[[File:God's_Rest.png|right|God's Rest]]
Part of the original Good Vanilla Factions, the '''Angels''' empower [[mana]] and [[spells]], and thus can help when aiming for the [[Trophies#Magic Trophies|magic trophy]] series.
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Good'''''
* '''[[Alignment#Leges|Leges]]''': '''''Order'''''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''':  '''''[[God's Hand]]''''' - Increase the production of all buildings by 150x your mana regeneration rate for 20 seconds.
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''':  '''''God's Rest''''' - Gives random [[Faction Coins]] based on your [[mana]] regeneration for each other spell you cast while God's Hand is active.<br />{{Formula|stat|\left\lfloor x^{1.1}\right\rfloor |mana regen per second}}
** Unlock requirement: Cast God's Hand on any Sunday.
* '''[[Heritage]]''': Increase mana regeneration rate by 10%.  
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Increase mana regeneration based on spells cast this game.<br />{{Formula|stat|1.31 \times x^{0.31}|spell casts (this game)}}
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''God's Throne''' -  Mana regeneration is increased by 50% while ''God's Hand'' is active.  
* '''[[Unique Buildings|Research Building]]''':  '''''Heaven Domain''''' (from Heaven Gates)  
* '''[[Research#Research#The Facilities & Related Factions|Research Facility]]''': '''''Divine'''''  
* '''[[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Leges Building]]''':  '''''Holy Sites''''' (from Cathedrals)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': None (All Vanilla Factions are enabled by default)

== Unique Buildings ==
[[File:Angel Unique Building Design.png|left]]
[[File:Special-building-angel.png|right|Heaven Domain button]]
[[File:Holy Site.png|right|Holy Site button]]
At R16, the Angels' building ''Heaven Gates'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Heaven's Domain''''', which is required for some [[challenges]] and [[research]] quests. 

At R100, the Angels' ''Cathedrals'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Holy Sites''''', which when bought will grant access to the [[Faction Union]] upgrade.{{Clr}}

== Angel Research ==
[[File:Research-new-progress-system-msg.PNG|right|250px]]
Upon reaching R16, the game advisor tells us that the Vanilla factions have gained tremendous power. Their power can be ours if we get ready and seek them again. 

To unlock Angel research, play the Angel faction and simply follow the appearing quests (Do not [[prestige]]). These can be done in separate game plays.
